## Checks

- [ ] `swift test` passes.
- [ ] `./build.sh` succeeds and the app launches.
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, `.env` files or local paths are staged.
- [ ] READMEs (EN/UK/RU) stay in sync.
- [ ] Screenshots in `docs/screenshots/{en,uk,ru}/` are updated if the UI changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry for a release change.

## Notes
